description: "Gambara" by Honoré de Balzac is a short story first published in 1837. Count Andrea Marcosini becomes obsessed with Marianna, a beautiful woman living in poverty with her husband Gambara, a brilliant but misunderstood composer whose music only sounds coherent when he's drunk.
